test_policy.notes: The undergraduate catalog says submitted standardized test scores are a voluntary submission of information the applicant wishes to share and are not an academic credential needed for admission. The international and first-year pages list no SAT/ACT requirement.

requirements.notes: Apply with the Common App or the Panther App. First-year file: official transcripts (final junior-year grades at minimum), an essay and one academic recommendation. International file adds notarized transcripts in English showing a 100-point or 4.0 GPA (otherwise a course evaluation, e.g. TEC), a passport copy, a US visa copy if already in the US and proof of English; after a conditional acceptance, an international financial certification form and notarized bank statements. The $50 fee is the College Navigator 2024-25 undergraduate fee; the admissions pages reviewed do not print it. Music and Theatre applicants must audition; pre-licensure Nursing needs a 3.0 overall and science GPA.

deadlines.label: International application deadline (fall 2027 entry)
deadlines.notes: The international page prints 'Fall Semester: April 1' without a year; treated here as fall 2027 entry. Admission is rolling and the catalog calls April 1 the priority date. The spring semester international deadline is Nov. 1 (year not printed).

deadlines.label: International student deposit deadline (fall 2027 entry)
deadlines.notes: Printed as 'Fall Semester: May 1' without a year. Priority housing deadline is 'mid-March' (no exact date printed).

english_policy.waiver_notes: Students from countries where English is not the primary language must show proof of English proficiency; waivers are considered case by case. Applicants meeting the listed scores enter their degree program directly. The international page lists IELTS, TOEFL and Duolingo; the undergraduate catalog also lists PTE Academic and ELS level 112, with lower minimums (TOEFL 530 paper / 71 online, IELTS 5.5 with no band below 5.0, Duolingo 85). No conditional or ESL pathway program is described on the pages reviewed.

english.notes: Online (iBT) score 71; paper-based minimum 530. The page does not mention the new 1-6 scale.
Minimum 6.0 with no band less than 6.0 on the international page; the catalog lists 5.5 with no band below 5.0.
International page minimum 100; the catalog lists 85.
Listed only in the undergraduate catalog, as 'a minimum score of 46-51'; no single minimum is printed.

cost.notes: Estimated 2026-27 direct-bill full-time tuition and mandatory fees: $15,444 NH resident, $26,872 out-of-state; room and meals $14,008 (double room, unlimited meal plan). Rates are not final until the June 2026 board meeting. The page lists no separate international rate; the scholarship table groups international students with out-of-state students.

aid.notes: Every admitted student is considered for GPA-based merit scholarships, assigned at the time of admission and renewable up to eight semesters. Fall 2027 entry (out-of-state/NEBHE/international, per year): 4.0+ Chancellor $16,000; 3.75-3.99 Presidential $15,000; 3.25-3.74 Deans $14,000; 2.75-3.24 Aspire $13,000; 2.50-2.74 Promise $9,000; 2.25-2.49 Achieve $5,000; below 2.24 Strive $3,000. Plus a $2,000 on-campus housing scholarship. Whether need-based aid exists for international students is not stated.

majors.notes: Requires overall GPA 3.0 or higher, 3.0 or higher in high school science (biology and chemistry required), Algebra I, II and Geometry, and a strong application essay. Seat limits are not stated on the page.
Applicants to the Music or Theatre programs must audition.

sat.note: No numeric SAT code is printed on the admissions pages reviewed; look it up in the College Board code search. Scores are optional.

act.note: No numeric ACT code is printed on the admissions pages reviewed; look it up at act.org. Scores are optional.

toefl.note: No TOEFL institution code is printed on the international page; ask Admissions or check the ETS code search.
